CREATE TABLE local_customers (

    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_request TEXT NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE local_lan_devices (

 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'The owner cannot be disabled or demoted'); END
